# Sound channel remaps for ported maps, applied by Kernel33.dll (soundchannels.c) right after the map's zone
# loads: every entry of each listed alias that the zone itself carries gets this channel (bits 9..14 of the
# alias flags at +0x38; nothing else changes). Aliases of other zones, and maps not listed, are left alone.
#
#   <map zone> <alias> <channel>
#
# <channel> is a name from 1.1.1.13's soundaliases/channels.def, or its index:
#   ambdist1 (1) / ambdist2 (2): priority 0, 6 voices; auto2 (4) / element (9): priority 1.
# Generated by usermaps\gen_sound_channels.py from fix_abandon_channels.py, fix_map_channels.py and
# fix_sumpf_channels.py; edit those tables and regenerate. '#' starts a comment.
